title: HERIT: Enabling Global Access to Hanja-to-English Historical Translation by Mitigating Temporal Bias
author: Dayeon Jeong, Kyeongpil Kang

summary: Historical archives are invaluable for multidisciplinary research but remain inaccessible globally due to severe language barriers. While manual translation is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, simply applying existing machine translation models is inadequate due to unique linguistic nuances and the temporal bias inherent in scarce human-labeled corpora.
takeaways: To address these challenges, we propose HERIT, a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline that leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to generate high-quality pseudo-labeled data from abundant Hanja-Korean corpora.

While manual translation is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, simply applying existing machine translation models is inadequate due to unique linguistic nuances and the temporal bias inherent in scarce human-labeled corpora.
Extensive automated and human evaluations demonstrate that HERIT consistently outperforms baselines.
